description: This file contains helper functions for extracting MAC addresses from MTD partition data for the Phicomm K2T device. It includes functions to load device-specific configuration JSON data from flash memory and to retrieve MAC addresses based on provided keys.

methods.name: k2t_config_load
methods.description: Loads JSON configuration data from a specific MTD partition named 'config' into the device's environment.

methods.name: k2t_get_mac
methods.description: Retrieves a MAC address value from the loaded JSON configuration data using a specified key.
